integrity.claim_scope: all finite fields, positive dimensions, and nonzero deformation parameters; exact image-rank distribution
integrity.evidence: self-contained algebraic argument and independently implemented finite-field tests

scientific_limitations: The theorem covers central sums with one nondegenerate split bilinear pairing and nonzero parameter, not all extra-special associative algebras. It counts idempotent algebra endomorphisms, not all endomorphisms or conjugacy orbits. The alternating/symplectic special case has previously known geometry; publication priority is provisional.
title: Complete retraction-rank spectra of split bilinear-product algebras over finite fields
